description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This is a patch release for 0.19.0. The previous release introduced the ability for companions to ask you questions, but the question cards’ styling and interactions weren’t where we wanted them to be. We’re following up with a refined layout, clearer visual hierarchy, and one-at-a-time question navigation to make answering more focused and comfortable.
We also addressed performance issues to make long conversations and split-pane resizing smoother, alongside fixes for delayed supplementary messages and loading and reading-position issues after editing or regenerating replies.
There’s still room for improvement, and we’ll keep refining these experiences in future releases.
